recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for this issue; any remaining disagreements would be implementation-specific validator behavior rather than a missing specification source change.
issue_request: FHIR-31732 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the Reference datatype. It reported that contained-resource guidance allows a contained resource to reference its container with "#", while ref-1 only accepted local fragments matching contained resource ids. The approved resolution was to add a FHIRPath branch allowing reference='#' when %rootResource != %resource.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by d87b97a367412efef9c243585bd036f4546fb9c5, "Update ref-1 to fix FHIR-31732", merged through HL7/fhir#1602. That source commit added or (reference='#' and %rootResource!=%resource) to source/datatypes/reference.xml, and the current branch contains that implementation.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists Reference as a datatype, maps Reference pages to references.html, marks Reference normative, and assigns it the ref constraint prefix, confirming that source/datatypes/reference.xml is current build-scope source for ref-1. FHIR-I minutes from 2021-09-13 record FHIR-31732 as a technical correction with FHIRPath changes. The earlier Zulip thread identified the same bare-# container-reference gap, and the later FHIR-37793 follow-up added the current reference.exists() implies guard without superseding the FHIR-31732 branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current ref-1 expression already reads reference.exists() implies (reference.startsWith('#').not() or (reference.substring(1).trace('url') in %rootResource.contained.id.trace('ids')) or (reference='#' and %rootResource!=%resource)), preserving the approved FHIR-31732 semantics while incorporating the later FHIR-37793 guard.
